'''HŠK Posušje''' ([[Croatian language|Croatian]]: ''Hrvatski športski klub Posušje'', <small>[[Literal translation|lit]]. '</small>Croat Sports Club Posušje') is a professional [[association football]] club based in [[Posušje]] that is situated in [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]]. The club is best known for winning the [[First League of Herzeg-Bosnia]] in 1999 and 2000, the [[First League of Herzeg-Bosnia|top flight ethnic Croat league]] in Bosnia and Herzegovina at the time.

Currently, Posušje competes in the [[First League of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina]], the second level of football in the country, and plays its home matches at the [[Mokri Dolac Stadium]], which has a capacity of 5,040 seats. The club was promoted to the [[Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina|Bosnian Premier League]] in 2021,<ref>{{cite web|url=https://sportsport.ba/fudbal/posusje-jedinstvo-izvjestaj/399445|title=Posušje se pobjedom protiv Jedinstva nakon 12 godina vratilo u Premijer ligu BiH!|date=19 May 2021|access-date=19 May 2021|language=bs|author=S. Grebović|publisher=sportsport.ba}}</ref> before being relegated in 2026.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://sportsport.ba/fudbal/borac-posusje-sloga-radnik-wwin-liga-bih/522811|title=Slavlje u Doboju, Posušje nakon poraza od Borca ispalo iz WWin lige BiH!|date=26 May 2026|access-date=27 May 2026|language=bs|author=Esmer Oštraković|publisher=sportsport.ba}}</ref>

Previously, Posušje won the southern group of the [[Second League of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina|Second League of FBiH]] in the 2017–18 season, going 12 rounds undefeated to start the season.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.jabuka.tv/hsk-posusje-na-pragu-ispisivanja-povijesti-glavina-zabio-za-pobjedu/|title=HŠK Posušje na pragu ispisivanja povijesti, Glavina zabio za pobjedu|language=hr|website=jabuka.tv|publisher=Jabuka TV|date=12 November 2017}}</ref> However, the club did not gain promotion after losing to [[FK Goražde|Goražde]] in the play-offs.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesb/bih2018.html|website=[[RSSSF]]|title=Bosnia and Herzegovina 2017–18}}</ref>

Previous names of the club have included '''NK Zidar''' (from 1950) and '''NK Boksit''' (from 1963), with the current name being adopted in the early 1990s. Posušje's fans are now known as the Poskoci (''Horned Vipers''), but were previously known as [[Torcida organizada|Torcida]]. The stadium's name, "Mokri Dolac", means 'Wet Valley'."}}
